def exposure_comparison(a,b,spans,frames):
    """Exact means and L1 difference of the piecewise-linear probe curves."""
    left,right=stats(a,spans),stats(b,spans)
    fields=['n','v','f_incident']
    frame_changes={str(frame):{k:stats(a,windows)[k]/stats(b,windows)[k]-1 for k in fields}
                   for frame,windows in frames.items()}
    l1={}
    for k in fields:
        numerator=denominator=0.
        for start,stop in spans:
            if any(start<x['day'][0]-1e-8 or stop>x['day'][-1]+1e-8 for x in [a,b]):
                raise ValueError('Refusing exposure-comparison extrapolation')
            t=np.unique(np.r_[start,stop,a['day'][(a['day']>start)&(a['day']<stop)],b['day'][(b['day']>start)&(b['day']<stop)]])
            delta=np.interp(t,a['day'],a[k])-np.interp(t,b['day'],b[k])
            cross=np.flatnonzero(delta[:-1]*delta[1:]<0)
            roots=t[cross]-delta[cross]*(t[cross+1]-t[cross])/(delta[cross+1]-delta[cross])
            knots=np.unique(np.r_[t,roots])
            av=np.interp(knots,a['day'],a[k]);bv=np.interp(knots,b['day'],b[k])
            numerator+=np.trapezoid(abs(av-bv),knots)
            denominator+=np.trapezoid(abs(bv),knots)
        l1[k]=float(numerator/denominator)
    return {'PN_GTI_mean_relative_change':{k:float(left[k]/right[k]-1) for k in fields},
            'PN_frame_GTI_mean_relative_changes':frame_changes,
